name: Safari Savanna
tagline: Sun-baked parchment with burnt-sienna accents, double hairline frames, expedition stamps, a survey map and Playfair Display headlines over tracked mono labels (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: sandy parchment gradient with dark brown ink and burnt-sienna sun accents

typography.style: high-contrast serif headlines with italic accents, readable serif body and small tracked mono field labels

best_for: Storytelling decks with a field-notebook or travel-magazine feel: expeditions, research trips, conservation and place-based stories. Works for narratives with a few clear numbers and a route or timeline.
avoid_for: High-energy product launches or data-dense dashboards that need a modern, high-contrast look.
